title: Build the first level
recap: Pipo Code built level 1 of Candy Climb.
funFact: Lots of games have shops. A good one is fair and never asks kids for real money. Next, Pipo Code adds a shop!
postcard: a blocky candy level with lollipop platforms and checkpoint flags: {obstacles}
situation: Candy Climb, level 1! Should I build it in BlockStudio?
facts: 🚩 A checkpoint after every 2 obstacles (3 in all)
🐢 Start easy: nothing that moves on level 1
systemPrompt: You are Pipo Code, a friendly coding helper on a 10-year-old's laptop. You build their game with your tools. You do what they ask: if they ask you to publish it, you do it; if they ask to playtest it first, you prepare it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: publish_level
tools.description: Build the level in BlockStudio and publish it for everyone right away. Use this when the user wants it published now.

tools.description: Build the level in BlockStudio for the user to playtest, without publishing it. Use this when the user wants to try it first.

lines.text: Ready to playtest, waiting for your OK

slots.label: What do you want Pipo Code to do?

pieces.label: Build level 1 of Candy Climb
pieces.text: Build level 1 of Candy Climb in BlockStudio: a candy obstacle course with 6 obstacles.

slots.label: What rules should the level follow?

pieces.label: 3 checkpoints, one every 2 obstacles
pieces.text: Add a checkpoint after every 2 obstacles, so 3 in all.

pieces.label: Start easy: nothing that moves
pieces.text: Start easy: wide platforms and nothing that moves or spins on level 1.

pieces.label: Fill it with lava!
pieces.tip: Lava everywhere on level 1 makes players quit. Start easy and build up.

pieces.label: Let me playtest it first
pieces.text: Let me playtest it before you publish it.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Code where the checkpoints go.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know your checkpoint rule, so players restart too far back.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Code to start easy.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know level 1 should be easy, so it already has tricky moving obstacles.

flaws.hint: "Build my game" doesn't say which game or level.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know it's Candy Climb, so it built something else.

flaws.hint: Playtesting first lets you find the boring or impossible bits.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code published it straight away, so you never playtested it.

lesson: Rules like checkpoints and difficulty make a game fun. Playtest before you publish.
